title: Quench Spectroscopy for Two-Dimensional Spin Models with Power-Law Interactions
summary: In this paper, we analytically compute the quench dynamics of simple product states that evolve under a spin-1/2 XY-model with power-law interactions in a staggered magnetic field. We use linear spin-wave theory as well as a low-energy theory that accounts for strong phase fluctuations. This allows us to provide an analytic expression for the dynamics of phase-type correlations with short-range interactions, where the linear spin-wave theory is known to fail.
